summary: The Republic of the Philippines filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a multi-tranche offering of U.S. dollar-denominated global bonds: $550M 4.625% notes due 2031, $1.65B 5.325% notes due 2036, and $300M 5.750% notes due 2051 (a reopening of an existing series). The bonds are direct, unsecured, unsubordinated general obligations ranking equally with other external debt. Interest is semi-annual; all are non-callable and mature at par. Settlement is conditional on central bank approval. Application has been made for listing on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange's Euro MTF. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance, not a special situation.
